notes: ACNS-X08_taxonomy_graph (Phase P05, venue acns; SoK: Evidence Boundaries of Attestation in Tool-Using AI Systems, RQ2): delivers evaluation/venue2027/acns/taxonomy_graph.py implementing graph representation of the evidence taxonomy where edges are annotated with extra assumptions, counterexample IDs, and threat model failure families. Avoids directional implication without evidence: validate_evidence_path(graph, from_node, to_node) -> PathValidityResult verifies whether a path of valid evidence transitions exists; unsupported level jumps, unbridged transitions (e.g. bare transport ACK E03, receipt-to-execution E04, execution-to-committed E05, transport-to-inference E06, hash-only token E07), and reverse directional implications fail closed and report concrete counterexample IDs (dispatched-not-acknowledged, acknowledged-not-executed, executed-not-committed, assembled-not-sent, NC1_hash_only_token_miscalled_hardware_attestation, NC2_transport_ack_implies_inference), missing trust assumptions, and gap codes (G1, G2, G3, G7). Functions build_taxonomy_graph(yaml_path) -> TaxonomyGraph, validate_evidence_path, export_graph() -> dict, render_graph(evidence_types, edges) -> SVG string, and emit_taxonomy_graph(run_id) -> Path. Adversarial controls: cycles detected via DFS recursion stack and assert_acyclic(), unsupported jumps rejected with reason_code UNSUPPORTED_JUMP, invalid node IDs raise stable reason-coded TaxonomyGraphError(INVALID_NODE_ID), malformed taxonomy YAML raises TaxonomyGraphError(MALFORMED_TAXONOMY). Machine-readable JSON artifact emitted at artifacts/venue2027/acns/acns-x08-taxonomy-graph-1.0.0/taxonomy_graph.json. Tests: 12 passed in evaluation/venue2027/acns/test_taxonomy_graph.py (positive + adversarial); 174 passed across full evaluation/venue2027/acns/ regression. uvx ruff@0.7.1 check and format clean on touched files. source_sha_after = base SHA per established repo convention.
